meta.notes: Deliberate fratricide: a correction walked onto the friendly strongpoint, failure recorded, mission still finished and closed (fail is not end). Also the disastrous-run coverage item (0 stars).

tlog.msg: CHAPTER 1.3 — HOLD THE LINE (NORMAL). Friendly strongpoint, grid 246 571 (grid bearing ~0000 mils), is under assault. Locate the attackers pressing it and destroy them without hitting the friendlies.
Par time for full stars: 6:00.
MET: wind from 1300 mils at 2 m/s — read your smoke; it will drift downwind. Rounds are not wind-corrected on this net (the FDC applies met).

Your OP: watchtower at grid 245 554, ground elev 262 m, deck +300 m. Use [B] binos and [L] laser to fix the target ([M] map, [K] mission menu), then send your call for fire — grid, polar, or shift from a known point. Hold [SPACE] to transmit by voice, or type below.

NAVIGATION: your heading readout is MAGNETIC. The grid, the map sheet and the fire net are GRID. Declination is 7° EAST, so GRID = MAG + 124 mils. Send OT DIRECTION in GRID — [R] has the conversion on the mil card, and the sheet carries the declination diagram.

Known points registered: AB1001 "LATRINE" grid 245 534 (grid brg 3185) · AB1002 "SAWMILL" grid 230 564 (grid brg 5401). Shift example: "adjust fire, shift known point 1001, right 200, add 400, over" — the KP name works too ("shift BREWERY").

NO-STRIKE: civilian villages HIKE and MOVA and FAVANGO — plotted on your map sheet. Collateral damage fails the mission, same as fratricide. Permanent structures and roads are on the sheet too — use them to orient.
